why_best: This motion bridges granular real-time tracking with high-level architectural context, giving operators an instant sense of structural hierarchy without breaking continuity.
why_bad: A flat, two-dimensional scaling transition or abrupt jump cut would strip away the physical sense of depth, flattening a complex operational network into static graphics.
trap: A near-miss will let contextual text labels flip alignment or tilt with the background geometry as the view expands, ruining screen legibility.
